questions.e: The Dow fell 848.75 points, or 1.64%, to close at 50,759.42. It had been down more than 1,000 points at its session low.
questions.h: It was a sizable drop, but less than 1,000 points at the close.
questions.q: On Tuesday, Nov 17, 2026, roughly how many points did the Dow Jones Industrial Average lose by the close?

questions.e: The Dow dropped 1.64%, versus 1.03% for the S&P 500 and 0.74% for the Nasdaq Composite, so blue chips took the hardest hit that day.
questions.h: The tech-heavy index actually held up best.
questions.q: Which major U.S. index posted the biggest percentage decline on Nov 17, 2026?

questions.e: Retail and food services sales rose 0.2% in October to $748.2 billion, after an unrevised 0.8% gain in September. They were up 6.8% from a year earlier.
questions.h: A small gain after a much bigger September jump.
questions.q: The Census Bureau's advance report released Nov 17 showed U.S. retail sales for October 2026 changed by how much from September?

questions.e: Nvidia reported revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year earlier, with Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion. It guided to about $130 billion for the next quarter.
questions.h: Revenue more than doubled from the year-ago $57.0 billion.
questions.q: Nvidia reported fiscal third-quarter results after the bell on Nov 17. About how much revenue did it report for the quarter?

questions.e: Home Depot's comparable sales rose 2.2% on total sales of $43.4 billion, up 4.9% from a year earlier. Adjusted EPS was $3.86.
questions.q: Home Depot reported third-quarter results on Nov 17. What happened to its comparable sales?
